stem: A new hire at Quillfeather Systems cloned the team repository and ran `terraform init`. They now ask where Terraform put the downloaded copies of the child modules and whether those copies belong in the repository. What is the right answer?

choices.text: In a `.terraform` subdirectory of the working directory, kept out of version control
In a `modules` folder beside the root `.tf` files, committed so everyone has identical code
In `.terraform.lock.hcl`, committed together with the provider selections
In a `.terraform` subdirectory of the working directory, committed so teammates skip the download

rationale: Terraform downloads module sources into a hidden `.terraform` subdirectory of the working directory, and that directory should not be committed. Nothing creates a committed `modules` folder next to the root files by default. The dependency lock file records provider selections, not module code or module versions. The `.terraform` directory itself should not be committed, even though that is where the copies land.
